full_judgment:
7. The learned Advocate-on-record in refusal of the contention of the appellant as to non-completion of the proceeding within the prescribed period has submitted that in reality proceeding against the appellant was concluded within 180 days in that date on which show cause notice was issued to be excluded because of the language of the Regulation “অবহিত করার পর একশত আশিটি কার্যদিবসের মধ্যে and in support of the said contention he has placed reliance on the language of section 12 of the Limitation Act. 

 8. The learned Counsel for the appellant as against the aforesaid submission of the learned Advocate-on-record for the Respondent has submitted that in section 12 of the Limitation Act procedure for computation of period of limitation as regard legal proceeding relates to suit appeal application and review but the proceeding against the appellant being not any of the same the provision of section 12 of the Limitation Act cannot be taken into consideration in computing the period for completion of the proceeding as provided in Regulation 43(8) of the Regulations. 

 9. On reading the provision of Regulation 43(8) of the regulations we are of the opinion that day on which show cause/charge sheet was communicated to a delinquent employee of an organisation, herein the appellant, the said date is to be excluded since the same is in consonance with the rules of computation of period either for the purpose of limitation of legal proceeding or enquiry before the Tribunal or for the departmental enquiry. The language of the Regulation 43(8) shows that the day on which show cause-charge sheet was submitted the same is to be excluded. In that view of the matter, we find that proceeding against the appellant was completed within 180 days as provides by Regulation 43(8) of the Regulations. The break-up of the total days consumed in completing the proceeding has been shown by the appellant upon taking into account the date on which the show cause notice was issued to him and that since this particular date is to be excluded from the total days consumed in completing proceeding as shown by the appellant, then it is seen that the proceeding was completed within 180 days as provides by Regulation 43(8) of the Regulations.
